mapper.insert: INSERT INTO run_checkpoint (enterprise_id, run_id, checkpoint_no, lease_version, state_json, framework_state_key, state_hash, updated_at) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{runId}, 1, #{version}, #{value}, #{stateKey}, #{value2}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE checkpoint_no = checkpoint_no + IF(state_hash = VALUES(state_hash), 0, 1), lease_version = VALUES(lease_version), state_json = VALUES(state_json), framework_state_key = VALUES(framework_state_key), state_hash = VALUES(state_hash), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
